predecessors.name: Italian Africa

predecessors.name: Ethiopian Empire
predecessors.text: the same state restored: the Ethiopian Empire annexed by Italy in May 1936

ledger.x: 1941: Ethiopia is liberated from Italian rule and the Ethiopian state is restored.
1941: most of Ethiopia is under British military occupation after the liberation.
1941: the Ogaden stays under British military administration.
31 January 1942: the second Anglo-Ethiopian Agreement ends British military occupation in most of Ethiopia.
1948: the British hand the Ogaden and the Haud back to Ethiopia.
15 September 1952: Eritrea joins Ethiopia in a federation.
1 September 1961: armed resistance begins.
15 November 1962: the federation ends and Eritrea becomes a province.
12 September 1974: the Derg deposes Haile Selassie.
March 1975: the monarchy is abolished.
July 1977: Somalia invades the Ogaden.
March 1978: Ethiopia regains the Ogaden.
1987: the Derg dissolves itself and founds the People's Democratic Republic of Ethiopia.
1991: the war of independence ends.
1991: Eritrea leaves Ethiopian rule.
May 1991: the EPRDF takes power and the Derg regime falls.
1995: Ethiopia becomes the Federal Democratic Republic.
6 May 1998: Eritrea attacks at Badme and the war begins.
February 1999: Ethiopia retakes Badme and holds it.
12 December 2000: the Algiers peace agreement ends the war.
2020: Ethiopia's hold on Badme ends.
3 November 2020: the Tigray War begins.
November 2020: Eritrean forces enter northern Tigray.
28 June 2021: the Tigray Defense Forces retake Mekelle and hold most of Tigray.
17-19 July 2021: the TDF attack into Afar.
August 2021: the TDF take Lalibela and Weldiya.
30-31 October 2021: the TDF take Dessie and Kombolcha.
20 December 2021: the TDF withdraw from Afar and Amhara.
December 2021: Lalibela and Weldiya are no longer held.
6 December 2021: government forces retake Dessie and Kombolcha.
17 October 2022: federal and Eritrean forces take Shire.
2 November 2022: the Pretoria cessation of hostilities.
23 March 2023: Tigray returns under a federal Interim Regional Administration.
2024: the Eritrean occupation of northern Tigray is closed at the last year of the data.

wars.name: Eritrean War of Independence
wars.outcome: Eritrea separates: the war ends in 1991 with the EPRDF's overthrow of the Derg, and Eritrea becomes independent by referendum in April 1993.

wars.name: Ogaden War
wars.outcome: Ethiopian-allied victory: Somali forces take 70% of the Ogaden within a month and about 90% by late September 1977, then are driven out between January and March 1978; no formal border change.

wars.name: Eritrean-Ethiopian War
wars.outcome: Ethiopian military advantage: Ethiopia occupies 'about a quarter of Eritrea's territory' by May 2000; the Algiers Agreement of 12 December 2000 and the Boundary Commission's ruling of April 2002 award Badme to Eritrea, but Ethiopia holds it until the 2020…

wars.name: Tigray War
wars.outcome: Cessation of hostilities signed 2 November 2022 in Pretoria; Western Tigray ceded to and occupied by Amhara regional authorities; Eritrea 'largely continued to occupy parts of Tigray as of 2023'; an Interim Regional Administration formed 23 March 2023.
